recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. Future changes to the extension definition, value set, or logical-model characteristic codes should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack; core should remain limited to the active type-characteristics data and references needed for the core build.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue requesting an explicit way to record datatype/type characteristics such as whether a type can be bound, ranged, length-constrained, or otherwise constrained, so tooling for FHIR and logical models would not have to rely only on a closed enumeration of core datatypes.
initial_application: No prior combined-branch audit existed for FHIR-24692. The issue appears to have been applied through unkeyed core commits: 0d7712ab28 added the type-characteristics extension, code system, and value set to the R5 core source; d196630c2c added the active [type-characteristics] mapping in source/fhir.ini; and 0e2302e482 added the datatype Type Characteristic Summary table. Later core commit dd468d4f17 moved extension definitions out of core while retaining the active core type-characteristics data.
additional_context: The current Extension Pack checkout defines StructureDefinition/structuredefinition-type-characteristics with StructureDefinition context, valueCode, required binding to ValueSet/type-characteristics-code, and root max='*'. Related Extension Pack issues FHIR-40843 and FHIR-41436 corrected repeatability to 0..*, FHIR-41599 added can-be-target, and FHIR-44357 handled description punctuation. Current core source still contains OIDs, an active [type-characteristics] section in source/fhir.ini, and a datatypes page table linked to the Extension Pack CodeSystem. Zulip discussion confirms active logical-model use and later extension-pack refinements without identifying a missing FHIR-core edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source change is needed because core already supplies the build-scoped datatype characteristic assignments and documentation, and the requested extension definition now belongs to the Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Later Extension Pack correction making structuredefinition-type-characteristics repeatable, confirming the extension is maintained outside current core source.
Parallel Extension Pack cardinality issue requiring the root extension max to be 0..*.
Extension Pack enhancement adding can-be-target for logical model reference targets.
Extension Pack editorial correction to the type-characteristics extension description.
